items.title: 68154_Gus Johnson oral history interview
items.q: Lucky Millinder and those guys called us the Western Dogs. And we swung them off the stage.

ctx.x: At the Savoy. When we got there, it was around -- almost 9:00. Lucky Millinder was playing. He was on the stand, he had stayed there because we wasn't there.
Yeah. So they were salty, huh?
